title: Tech Note: 4D Server, Dongle and Expansion Pack

historical_commentary.text: Hardware dongles for software licensing were common in the late 1990s but have been entirely replaced by software-based licensing systems. The Expansion Pack concept and dongle-based licensing reflect an era of physical copy protection. 4D has long since moved to software-based license management.
related_updates: Hardware dongles are no longer used for 4D licensing
4D now uses software-based license management and online activation
The Expansion Pack concept has been replaced by modern licensing tiers
